amendment5.recipe: scripts/expressivity_1p3b.py released strict loaders with Schedule-Free train/y weight recovery; full bf16 fine-tune, fresh AdamW(0.9,0.95), batch32, wd0.01, clip0.5, 300-update warmup then constant matched1e-3; no prior optimizer state loaded
amendment5.training: Fresh procedural generate_batch on every update with seed0/1/2 streams paired across arms; archived128 pool unused; no pilot continuation
amendment5.evaluation: Same X-series frozen512val/512test at128/512/1024 drivers plus2 initialization tokens; joint class61*x+y over full pretrained vocab, causal right-pad-to16 sliced before loss/scoring
amendment5.selection: Max exact joint-state validation accuracy, then lower validation CE, then earlier update; selection_frozen persisted before test/x4/x8; all3 seeds, never best-of-seed
amendment5.plateau: Eligibility>=10000; every250 completed updates; trailing2000 best-val gain<0.001 (0.1pp) AND first250/final250 relative train-loss mean improvement<0.001 (0.1%); strict thresholds; cap60000; calibrated rule from amendment#4, not a proof of convergence
amendment5.reference_correction: Task shorthand8.224 corrected before launch by live supervisor: ln(3721)=8.221747728346623, displayed8.221748 nats; 8.224 is only the task-spec shorthand, not an equality. Below-reference loss indicates learned predictive signal, not by itself deep computation.
amendment5.supersession: Matched1e-3 for BOTH arms supersedes pilot per-architecture E97@2e-4/GDN2@1e-3 reading, not archived evidence. X2b5e-5, X2c failed pilots, X3 symmetric8M grid/difficulty/one-step and ablation results all stand unchanged. No extra ablations/diagnostics launched by X4.
amendment5.capacity: If free capacity <400GiB at a checkpoint check, retain best-val chain, every10K grid, latest250 rolling, own stop, legacy fixed {1000,4000,8000,12000,16000,18269}, and all known headline stop steps; scan published frozen selections each prune. Each prune records removed steps and retained hashes. Any cross-arm panel cell whose checkpoint was already pruned before its step became required is reported as unavailable/pruned - never imputed, never re-created by interpolation, never silently dropped. Stop steps broadcast via selection_frozen.json; running arms scan each250 check.
amendment5.storage: Binary weights only off-repo at /mnt/nvme1n1/erikg/invertible_stage4_13b/<run>/; receipts bind absolute paths, bytes and SHA256. Capacity checks target actual weights filesystem. JSON/logs/pools remain this results root. No older roots moved or pruned; X3 retention unchanged.
amendment5.resources: Six concurrent single-GPU processes on six exclusive scripts/gpu_lease.sh leases explicitly approved; single-writer implementation/debugging; local lambda01 only
amendment5.resilience_requirements: Not applicable: no DiLoCo behavior changed, no Frontier/Slurm or WorksGood service
